description: Private, read-only coordination. Converts the person's own description into a nonclinical coordination frame, routes explicit emergency/crisis/withdrawal/safeguarding signals to qualified humans, and never diagnoses, treats, prescribes, or creates an employer-facing health record.

safetySignal.description: Only pass a stronger signal when the user/context explicitly supports it. Never infer one from vague distress.

summary.description: Minimum-necessary description of what is making life or care harder. Do not include names, date of birth, full address, medical-record number, insurance/member id, account credentials, or other identifiers.

name: understand_need
title: Turn a health or care problem into bounded coordination work
